integrity: All 65536 ordered labeled binary four-state transition pairs are exhaustively checked. Two independent state-complexity-maximality engines agree on every pair. A normalized 256-map census independently verifies the antipodality criterion, and all maximal pairs are canonicalized under all state relabelings and the letter swap.
scientific_limitations: The result is a complete four-state binary classification only. It does not give a necessary-and-sufficient criterion for arbitrary state size. The labeled and isomorphism-class counts use the explicitly stated state/alphabet symmetry conventions.
title: Complete four-state classification for maximal synchronizing-word state complexity
